hooks.command: [Console]::InputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $data = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $data.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -match 'package-lock\.json') { Write-Output '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Blocked: edit package.json and run npm install instead"}'; exit 2 }

[Console]::InputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $data = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $data.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -match '\.env') { Write-Output '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Blocked: .env files contain secrets and must not be edited by Claude"}'; exit 2 }

[Console]::InputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $data = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $data.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -match 'globals\.css|tailwind\.config') { Write-Output '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "Reminder: verify dark mode visually after this change"}}' }

[Console]::InputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $data = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $data.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -match '\.(ts|tsx)$') { npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 20 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } }
